title: Example: Papyrus Context
tagline: NPCs remember the favors you did them, through PapyrusUtil data read straight into their prompts.
description:
The second SkyrimNet plugin example. Gifts to NPCs are kept in a favor ledger with PapyrusUtil's StorageUtil, sent to SkyrimNet as a custom event type, and read into each NPC's prompt with the papyrus_util decorator. An NPC who owes you can repay the favor.

**Requires:** ExampleContext.esp (shipped with this mod) and PapyrusUtil.
author: example
